title: Changes made to Command Palette config not detected by PowerToys 'Backup and restore'
author: ianisl
summary: PowerToys Backup and restore does not detect or preserve Command Palette package-local settings, so CmdPal changes neither trigger a backup nor return after reinstall.
next_action: Reclassify this as a Command Palette backup/export enhancement and define ownership and restore compatibility before implementation.

confidence.rationale: The discussion uniformly describes absent CmdPal backup support and a manual LocalState workaround.

judgment.rationale: The discussion consistently describes an omitted product capability rather than a regression in an existing Command Palette backup contract.
evidence: Changing a Command Palette extension setting does not make the PowerToys backup page consider settings changed.
A commenter confirms Command Palette settings were not restored after reinstall.
The thread identifies the package LocalState location as the current manual backup workaround.
judgment.recommended_action: Reclassify this as a Command Palette backup/export enhancement and define ownership and restore compatibility before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: This is a missing backup/export capability with unresolved product and data-ownership requirements, not a demonstrated regression in an existing contract.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Backup and restore does not detect or preserve Command Palette package-local settings, so CmdPal changes neither trigger a backup nor return after reinstall.
known_information: The original report is against PowerToys 0.95.1.
Command Palette stores settings under its packaged application's LocalState.
Multiple users request export or backup coverage for CmdPal and Dock customization.
inferences: The main PowerToys backup inventory likely does not include the separately packaged Command Palette data boundary.
issue_context.analysis: A code fix should not be implied until product owners define which CmdPal settings are portable, how package identity changes are handled, and whether extensions own separate data.
initial_investigation: Read the full live body and all six comments.
Confirmed the issue has no assignee, linked closing PR, or evidence that CmdPal backup was previously supported.

actions.label: Reclassify as CmdPal backup enhancement

comment.body: Command Palette settings are currently outside the behavior users expect from PowerToys Backup and restore, and the thread indicates they live in the packaged app's LocalState. This should be tracked as a Command Palette backup/export enhancement rather than a change-detection bug. Before implementation, please define which core, Dock, and extension settings are portable and how restore should handle package-version or extension-schema changes.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.
